OwnedDefinition_974839bc01295c846df8912a.description:
Constant unified person shape — every row carries every field. Investor aggregates live
under `investor_highlights` (null for non-investors); discriminator flags `is_investor` /
`is_angel` / `has_led_deal` and `investment_firms` stay top-level. `employment_history`
and `education_history` are capped at 3 in the search response; the detail endpoint
returns the full lists.

education_history.description: Education records (max 3 items in search; full list on detail endpoint)

employment_history.description: Recent employment (max 3 items in search; full list on detail endpoint)

filtered_deal_count.description: Count of deals matching the `investor.deals.*` filters. Populated only when any `investor.deals.*` filter is present; otherwise null.

filtered_lead_count.description: Of the matching deals, how many the person/firm led. Populated only when any `investor.deals.*` filter is present.

filtered_most_recent_date.description: Most recent matching-deal date. Populated only when any `investor.deals.*` filter is present.

has_led_deal.description: Whether the person has ever led a deal

investment_firms.description: Firms the person invests under (empty for pure angels)

anyOf.description: Aggregated investor activity. Null when `is_investor` is false.

is_angel.description: Whether the person makes angel investments

is_investor.description: Whether the person has any tracked investment activity
